name: android-test-harness
title_zh: 没有真机也能跑安卓，每步截图发回 Telegram
tagline_zh: 手边没安卓机、私有仓库又不想买云测：在免费 Linux runner 上编译 KMP 项目、装 APK。
tagline_en: No device, no paid cloud test farm: compile your private KMP app on a free Linux runner, install the APK, tap.
desc_en: Build and RUN an Android app on an emulator in GitHub Actions — compile a private Kotlin/KMP project on free Linux runners, install the APK, tap through it, screenshot every step, and report to Telegram, a GitHub issue, or a secret gist. Use when asked to test an Android app in CI, get screenshots or video of an Android app, diagnose which screens crash, or when no device is available. Repo: oranb
why_zh: 它把「哪个页面崩了」变成一张张带顺序的截图，而不是一行 exit code 1。跑完还知道去哪找你。
why_en: It turns "which screen crashed" into an ordered strip of screenshots instead of a bare exit code 1 — and knows where to deliver.
limit_zh: 只跑 GitHub Actions 的 Linux runner，本地和 macOS 用不了；模拟器无 GPU 加速。
limit_en: GitHub Actions Linux runners only — no local or macOS use. Emulator has no GPU accel, so it's slow and useless for perf testing. Screenshots stop.
title_en: Run an Android app in CI and screenshot every tap
